about_short_description.short_description: MejorCDT is an investment platform for Latin America that aims to make investing safe and simple.

product.name: Simulador de CDT (CDT Simulator)
product.description: An online tool that allows users to simulate and compare CDT interest rates from multiple banks in real time to select the best investment option.

product.name: CDT Opening Service
product.description: A service that facilitates opening Certificates of Deposit (CDTs) with partner banks remotely, without requiring users to visit bank branches.

product.name: CDT Flexible (Flexible CDT)
product.description: A product that allows investors to withdraw up to 10 million COP from their CDT before maturity without penalties, subject to certain conditions.

product.name: CDT Recargable (Reloadable CDT)
product.description: A CDT product that allows investors to add funds to their existing CDT investment at any time, increasing their investment without opening a new CDT.
